<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the base peak at m/z 179.0946 likely corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral molecular mass of ≈ 178.09 Da. The formula C₁₁H₁₄O₂ has a monoisotopic mass of 178.099 Da, matching the observed mass within typical instrument tolerance, making it the most plausible molecular formula.</thought>
<final_answer>C11H14O2</final_answer>
